user.title: Add a NETGEAR switch
user.description: A NETGEAR Plus (smart managed) switch, such as a GS105E, GS108E or GS308EP. The integration logs in to its web interface; the model is found by itself.

data_description.host: The address of the switch. Give it a fixed address, in your router or on the switch.
data_description.password: The password of the switch's web interface.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: The switch at {host} refuses the password.

data_description.password: The password of the switch's web interface.

reconfigure.title: Address and password
reconfigure.description: For when the switch got another address or another password.

data_description.password: The password of the switch's web interface.

error.cannot_connect: No supported switch answers at this address ({reason}). Is the address right, and can Home Assistant reach the switch's web interface?
error.invalid_auth: The switch refuses the login. The password is wrong, or the switch has no free login session: log out of its web interface in your browser and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error: {reason}. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.another_switch: That is another switch. Add it as a new one instead.

command_error.message: The switch at {host} did not take the command: {reason}

command_refused.message: The switch at {host} refused the command.
